comment:
* The base interface for implementations of message authentication codes (MACs).
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public void init(CipherParameters params) throws IllegalArgumentException
methods.comment:
* Initialise the MAC.
     *
     * @param params the key and other data required by the MAC.
     * @exception IllegalArgumentException if the params argument is
     * inappropriate.

methods.name: public String getAlgorithmName()
methods.comment:
* Return the name of the algorithm the MAC implements.
     *
     * @return the name of the algorithm the MAC implements.

methods.name: public int getMacSize()
methods.comment:
* Return the block size for this MAC (in bytes).
     *
     * @return the block size for this MAC in bytes.

methods.name: public void update(byte in) throws IllegalStateException
methods.comment:
* add a single byte to the mac for processing.
     *
     * @param in the byte to be processed.
     * @exception IllegalStateException if the MAC is not initialised.

methods.name: public void update(byte[] in, int inOff, int len) throws DataLengthException, IllegalStateException
methods.comment:
* @param in the array containing the input.
     * @param inOff the index in the array the data begins at.
     * @param len the length of the input starting at inOff.
     * @exception IllegalStateException if the MAC is not initialised.
     * @exception DataLengthException if there isn't enough data in in.

methods.name: public int doFinal(byte[] out, int outOff) throws DataLengthException, IllegalStateException
methods.comment:
* Compute the final stage of the MAC writing the output to the out * parameter. *

* doFinal leaves the MAC in the same state it was after the last init. * * @param out the array the MAC is to be output to. * @param outOff the offset into the out buffer the output is to start at. * @exception DataLengthException if there isn't enough space in out. * @exception IllegalStateException if the MAC is not initialised.

methods.name: public void reset()
methods.comment:
* Reset the MAC. At the end of resetting the MAC should be in the
     * in the same state it was after the last init (if there was one).

public void update(byte[] in, int inOff, int len) throws DataLengthException, IllegalStateException
public int doFinal(byte[] out, int outOff) throws DataLengthException, IllegalStateException
